summary: p99 latency regression on long-context requests after Runtime 1.21 canary (Kernel auto-selection v2) on L40S
environment: prod / us-east / Dedicated pool: nw-analytics-ded-01 / GPU: NVIDIA L40S (SM89) / Driver: 550.54.14 / CUDA: 12.4 / Runtime: 1.21.0-canary.3
description:
Issue summary
- Customer reports p99 latency regression for long-context summarization workloads immediately after we enabled Runtime 1.21 canary on their Dedicated pool. Regression appears only for long-context requests (>= ~16k prompt tokens) and only on NVIDIA L40S.

Impact
- Customer-visible tail latency increase on long-context routes.
- Reported baseline (Runtime 1.20 / selector v1): p99 ~4.8–5.4s @ ~20k prompt tokens, 256–512 decode tokens.
- After canary (Runtime 1.21 / selector v2 enabled): p99 ~8.9–10.6s for same workload; p50/p90 mostly unchanged.
- No correctness issues reported. Error rate stable.

Customer context
- Northwind Analytics uses Redwood Dedicated for long-context summarization (document ingestion + map-reduce style prompts). Workload is bursty but within reserved throughput.

Environment
- Dedicated pool: nw-analytics-ded-01
- Region: us-east
- GPU SKU: NVIDIA L40S (SM89)
- Driver/CUDA: 550.54.14 / CUDA 12.4
- Runtime: 1.21.0-canary.3
- Feature: Kernel auto-selection v2 enabled via canary gate for Llama family

Steps to reproduce (as reported)
1) Send chat.completions with large prompts (~16k–32k tokens) and max_output_tokens 256–512.
2) Observe p99 latency increase vs previous runtime.
3) Short prompts (<4k) appear unaffected.

Observed signals
- Regressions correlate with selector choosing a different prefill kernel under v2 for the LONG seq bucket on L40S.
- Telemetry shows increased time in prefill stage; decode stage stable.

Example request IDs (customer-provided)
- req_7f2d5c8f2d8a4e1e (2026-02-20 18:12:44Z)
- req_3c19a0d91fb44b26 (2026-02-20 18:17:09Z)

Initial hypothesis
- Mis-selection in v2 for long-context prefill on L40S (SKU mapping + seq-bucket thresholds) causing fallback to a kernel variant with worse long-context characteristics on SM89.

Logs/snippets (redacted)
- Selection trace (sampled):
  - model_family=llama
  - seq_bucket=LONG
  - gpu_sku=l40s_sm89
  - chosen_prefill_kernel=fa3_fused_prefill_sm89 (candidate_score=0.71)
  - fallback_prefill_kernel=fa2_triton_prefill_sm89
  - chosen_decode_kernel=fa2_decode_sm89
- Perf counters summary (internal): prefill_ms +62% at 20k prompt; decode_ms within +/-3%.

Requested outcome
- Immediate mitigation (restore previous tail latency) and a safe path to re-enable v2 once fixed/guarded.

resolution: Mitigated by disabling Kernel auto-selection v2 for affected Llama models on the customer’s Dedicated L40S pool (nw-analytics-ded-01, us-east) and adding a temporary kernel deny rule preventing selection of fa3_fused_prefill_sm89 for LONG seq bucket on L40S. Customer confirmed p99 latency returned to pre-canary baseline. No errors/correctness regressions observed.

Coordinate a controlled re-enable canary for Northwind (30–60 min window) with dashboards + explicit rollback trigger (p99 regression >10% for LONG bucket).
